title: lanekeep configuration
description: Configuration for lanekeep, an architectural conformance checker. Rules are TypeScript programs; this file says which of them to run and over what.

$schema.description: URL of this schema. Editors read it to offer completion and validation.

include.description: Globs selecting the files to check. Relative to the project root.

exclude.description: Globs removing files from the selection. Applied after include.

namespaces.description: Rule-id namespaces this project uses beyond `local`. A rule whose namespace is not declared is rejected, so a typo in an id is an error rather than a rule that silently never runs. `lanekeep` is reserved for built-ins.

severity.description: Override the severity a rule declares for itself, by rule id.

timeouts.description: Execution budgets, in milliseconds. Breaching one cancels the run and exits 2 rather than reporting a partial result as a clean one.

rule.description: Per-invocation budget for a single rule handler.

global.description: Wall-clock budget for the whole run.

rules.description: The rules to run, in order. A string uses a rule as it comes; the object form calls it with options, which is what a rule that takes configuration expects.

oneOf.description: A built-in, as `lanekeep/<name>`, or a path to a local rule module such as `./lanekeep/rules/mine.ts`.

rule.description: The rule's specifier, as in the string form.

options.description: Passed to the rule. Its shape is the rule's own — see docs/built-in-rules.md for the built-ins.

restrictions.reason: route it through the payments package
